Empty.description: maxLength 0 admits only the empty string.

Effort.description: So a oneOf member with it is that string.

NoString.description: minLength above maxLength admits no string.

Short.description: Other lengths are not a type.

Lengths.description: Lengths count characters, not UTF-16 units, and drop the enum values they reject.

Mixed.description: A string keyword leaves the other values alone.

Pattern.description: pattern drops the values it does not match.

Range.description: Bounds drop the numbers outside them.

Exponents.description: Bounds compare numbers by value, exponents too, and leave other kinds alone.

Multiples.description: multipleOf by decimal value, not floating point.

ConstOut.description: A const the keywords reject admits nothing.

Exact.description: Bounds that admit one number are it.

InclusiveTighter.description: Of minimum and exclusiveMinimum, the tighter.

Zero.description: A multipleOf that is not positive is not read.

NoInteger.description: Bounds with no integer between them admit no integer.

NoNumber.description: minimum above maximum admits no number.

Open.description: Nor do exclusive bounds that meet.

Wide.description: Other ranges are not a type.

BadPattern.description: A pattern JavaScript cannot read drops nothing.

ZeroStep.description: A multipleOf that is not positive is not read between bounds either.
